description: Explorers in a hot-air balloon land on an island, figuring that they must be the only inhabitants. The men propose to build a canoe so they can survey the island in search of other human life. Many adventures follow, one after another. They find a large chest filled with provisions and tools. Setting off in search of who might have left the chest, the travelers make their way through the Mercy River to the sea. During their trek, the men find remnants of the balloon they arrived in. Back at camp (Granite House) they find their ladder to the house has been removed--by invading orangutans. Soon the animals are defeated, except for one, whom they tame to become a house servant. The men construct a bridge over the river. They protect their abode by surrounding it on all sides with water. They undertake projects to make their colony habitable and comfortable. They create a hydraulic lift to replace the ladder. They build a seagoing boat for further exploration. Eventually they discover another human on Tabor Island, bringing him back to their now-well-stocked colony. (Bill Boerst) In other translations this book is part of "The Mysterious Island".

description:
Most cybersecurity podcasts are made by technical people, for technical people. CEOs don't listen to them. Frankly, neither do I.
The Cyber CEO is different. I'm Robert O'Brien, a tech founder who has spent 30 years building, scaling and selling businesses, including MetaCompliance, the security awareness platform I grew to over 200 people before its sale to European private equity. I've lived on the inside of organisations where cybersecurity was taken seriously and others where it absolutely wasn't. I know what the difference looks like, and I know what it costs.
This podcast exists because the conversation about cybersecurity keeps happening at the wrong level. Every week, I sit down with CEOs, board members and business leaders to talk about what it actually takes to build an organisation that won't be taken out by a breach, a scam or a supply chain failure. No jargon, no scare tactics, no technical rabbit holes. Just honest conversations about leadership, accountability and what a cyber-first culture looks like in practice.
If you run a business and you've quietly wondered whether you're doing enough, this is the podcast for you. And if your answer is "my IT team handles that", then it's especially the podcast for you.
New episodes every month. Follow wherever you get your podcasts.

title: Nobody Special
author: Nobody Special Podcast
description:
Somewhere along the way, "ordinary" turned into an insult. Nobody Special pushes back.

Each week, host Chris makes the case for a good, ordinary life — the kind most of us are actually living, out in the wide middle of the bell curve. Not famous. Not falling apart. Just here, and doing pretty okay. It's a calm, funny antidote to hustle culture, for anyone who's ever hit an ordinary Tuesday and quietly wondered, "is this it?" — and wants the answer to be: yeah, and that's plenty.

No gurus. No morning routines. No "crush your goals." Just short, honest episodes — about five minutes each — that take the pressure to be exceptional and let a little air out of it.

One thing to be clear about: ordinary isn't lazy. This isn't a case for doing less. It's a case for pointing everything you've got at what actually matters — the people, the craft, the quiet Tuesday — instead of at a scoreboard that never stops moving.

If you're tired of being told your life is a fixer-upper, you're in the right place.

New episodes regularly. Follow along — and go have an ordinary week. We mean that as a compliment.

title: Strange Things Among Us
author: Justin Weston
description: Strange Things Among Us is an atmospheric storytelling podcast exploring forgotten places and original creatures. Strange Places uncovers the documented history, local folklore, and reported paranormal experiences behind haunted towns, buildings, roads, and cemeteries. author: Blanket Fort Hope
description:
Every child deserves safety, dignity, and the opportunity to heal. Unsilenced is a Blanket Fort Hope podcast hosted by Founder and CEO Alexa James and Executive Director Kim Mashego — two women on the front lines of the fight against human trafficking in Alabama and beyond.Each episode pulls back the curtain on the realities of trafficking, restoration, and the faith that drives this mission forward. From raw personal testimony to honest conversations with advocates, survivors, and leaders, Unsilenced exists to amplify the voices that trafficking tried to silence — and to remind every listener that hope is still being written.
Subscribe, share, and join the fight.
Visit blanketforthope.org to learn how you can get involved.

title: Heal Deeper: Sex Addiction, Pornography, and Betrayal Trauma Recovery - Stop Just Cutting the Crabgrass
author: Dr Chris Samuels
description:
Heal Deeper is a podcast dedicated to moving beyond surface-level conversations around sex addiction, pornography, betrayal, and relationships. Rather than focusing solely on behaviour management or temporary sobriety, this podcast explores what true, lasting repair actually requires.

At its heart, the project is about helping people understand the deeper roots beneath compulsive sexual behaviours, relational pain, secrecy, shame, and disconnection. We are shifting the conversation away from simply managing symptoms and toward meaningful healing that addresses the biological, emotional, psychological, cultural, and relational factors driving these patterns.

This podcast acknowledges that addiction does not happen in isolation, and neither does healing. Through honest conversations, professional insight, lived experiences, and compassionate education, listeners will be guided through the complexities of recovery, betrayal trauma, rebuilding trust, emotional regulation, intimacy, attachment, and reconnection.

Heal Deeper is designed to support not only individuals struggling with compulsive behaviors, but also partners, couples, and practitioners seeking a deeper understanding of the recovery journey.
The goal is not simply to help people stop the behaviour.
The goal is to help people understand the roots beneath the behaviour so healing can occur at a deeper level.

Because healing is not about continually cutting back the visible symptoms.

It is about addressing what keeps growing underneath.

This is not simply a podcast about healing symptoms or changing behaviors.

About remembering your true nature, restoring intimacy with Christ, reclaiming your inner authority, and liberating yourself from the forces that have kept your consciousness bound.


Each episode offers teachings, practices, reflections, and conversations designed to help you deepen your relationship with God, embody your soul more fully, and create lasting transformation from the inside out.


If you've spent years trying to heal your life but still find yourself caught in the same unconscious loops...

Welcome to The Financial Madrina: the podcast where mental health meets money.


Hosted by Sara Diaz, a Certified Financial Social Worker and Financial Wellness Coach, The Financial Madrina helps first-generation professionals heal their relationship with money and build lasting financial wellness.

Com relatos de pacientes, familiares e profissionais, a série destaca a importância da enfermagem para uma assistência mais segura, humanizada e qualificada — e também olha para quem está do outro lado do cuidado.

As reportagens são do repórter Pedro Jellinek, com produção de Isabella Freitas, edição de texto de Maria Fernanda Cinini e edição de áudio de Agnaldo Silva.

description:
Songs everyone heard. Nobody was listening.

Every big pop song is a confession that got mistaken for entertainment. Someone tells the truth about the worst thing that happened to them, sets it to a beat, and a million people sing along without hearing a word.

Big Songs, Bigger Questions takes one of those songs at a time — the ones you danced to at weddings, the ones stuck in your head since you were a teenager — and asks the bigger question underneath it. Can fast love ease the mind? Is it better to need no one? Who are you pretending to be? What did that song teach you about love, and was any of it true?

Fifteen minutes. One song. One question worth sitting with.

New episodes weekly.

This podcast is a place to share those stories and hear from the people who are boots on the ground every day—Realtors, lenders, title professionals, and community leaders—about what it truly means to serve, make an impact, and create lasting change through real estate.

description: Range to Ridge: Adventures with Kim Rose is where the stories get a little longer, the conversations go a little deeper, and you hear about the parts that don't always make it onto social media.  From competitive shooting and days at the range to hunting, fishing, backroads, family traditions, and life outdoors in Northern Canada, this podcast is about learning as we go and sharing the stories that come with it.  I'll take you behind the scenes of matches, hunts, adventures, wins, mistakes, lessons learned, and probably a few things that didn't go remotely according to plan. We'll talk shooting and hunting techniques, gear and preparation, outdoor skills, the people I've met along the way, and the traditions and communities that keep this lifestyle alive.  I'm not here pretending to know everything. I'm here because I love learning, asking questions, trying things, getting better, and sharing what I learn along the way.  Some episodes will teach you something. Some will tell a story. Some might make you want to grab your rifle, fishing rod, or truck keys and go make a few stories of your own.  This is Range to Ridge.  Aim True | Live Wild.

title: When Trust Turns Tragic Podcast
author: Latasha Dixon
description:
When Trust Turns Tragic explores the real stories behind betrayal, toxic relationships, dangerous friendships, and complicated family dynamics. As many of you know from Real Talk Tasha, these are the kinds of conversations I've always been passionate about.

Each episode takes a deeper look at true crime cases where trust was shattered, warning signs were missed, and the people closest to that person became part of the tragedy. We examine the psychology, manipulation, motives, and relationship dynamics that help explain how these heartbreaking cases unfolded. This is what happens when trust turns tragic.

title: New Era Reseller
author: Brian and Robin Joy Olson
description:
New Era Reseller is the podcast for regular people who want to build a real income using arbitrage strategies, without gimmicks, gurus, or guesswork. Each week we break down the moves that work right now: how to find products that actually sell, how to read the data so you stop guessing, and how to price and restock for steady profit.

But this is not only about the numbers. Building a business builds you. So alongside the tactics we talk about the habits, mindset, and small daily wins that turn a side hustle into something that lasts.

This is for people who want to build a predictable, sustainable, scalable source of income, without feeling like they are putting money into a slot machine. No hacks. No tricks. Just real business principles, and a practical playbook for building a business, and a life, you are proud of.

New episodes every week. Follow so you never miss one.

description: Welcome to The Awkward Small Group Leader—the podcast for anyone who's ever left youth group thinking, "Well... that was awkward." No perfect leadership advice here—just real conversations, plenty of awkward moments, and a faithful Savior who loves using ordinary people.

Music 101 is where every beat tells a story. Journey through the fascinating world of music as we explore the artists, genres, albums, instruments, songwriting, production, and cultural movements that have shaped the soundtrack of our lives. From the timeless masterpieces of classical music and jazz to the revolutionary sounds of rock, pop, hip-hop, country, electronic, and world music, each episode uncovers the stories, creativity, and passion behind the songs we love.
Discover the lives of legendary musicians, the origins of iconic genres, the evolution of recording technology, and the moments in history that transformed the music industry forever. Whether you're a lifelong music enthusiast, an aspiring musician, or simply curious about the stories behind your favorite songs, Music 101 offers engaging discussions, historical insights, expert perspectives, and fascinating musical discoveries that will deepen your appreciation for the universal language of music.

Often, God allows us to go through difficult moments so that we can be the answer to someone else's prayer and help them navigate their own storms. Drawing from the Holy Bible, the Book of Mormon, and inspiring personal testimonies, host Jericho explores how we can find hope, healing, and purpose through Jesus Christ.

title: Surfing Your Edge: Where Fear and Possibility Meet
author: Kristine Goad
description:
Surfing Your Edge is the personal growth podcast for people who know they’re meant for more—but don’t want a life that only looks good on paper.
Hosted by Kristine Goad, the Surfing Your Edge Coach, each episode brings honest conversations, personal stories, and practical insights to help you transform your relationship with fear, trust yourself more deeply, and experiment your way into a bigger, bolder, more badass life.
Together, you’ll explore courage, confidence, reinvention, and what it means to prioritize joy, wonder, peace, purpose, and possibility in rapidly changing, often chaotic times.
This isn’t about chasing perfection or fixing yourself. It’s about making friends with fear, surfing the edge of your comfort zone, and becoming more fully who you were born to be.

title: Energy Transition Desk with Lisa Wood

Now a strategic advisor to clean energy startups and venture investors, Lisa covers the full energy transition — clean power, natural gas, and the messy space where new technology meets the market.

Each episode features candid peer-level conversations with the founders, investors, energy executives, and policymakers doing the hard work of commercializing energy technology. What’s working, what’s not, and what it really takes to succeed in one of the most complex markets in the world. New episodes every other week!

title: The Whigham School Podcast
author: Steve Whigham and Jeremy Patterson, PhD
description:
The Whigham School Podcast explores how education must evolve to prepare leaders for the future.


Through conversations with founder Steve Whigham, Dr. Jeremy Patterson, educators, global thinkers, and changemakers, the podcast examines how learning can move beyond traditional classrooms to cultivate global awareness, cultural intelligence, moral courage, and a commitment to meaningful impact.

The Whigham School is a graduate-level Global Studies program redefining education through immersive, real-world experiences across six continents and more than 40 countries. Rather than focusing solely on information, it is designed to form leaders who understand the world deeply and are equipped to engage it with wisdom and purpose.


Inspired by the mission of The Whigham School and the leadership philosophy behind Steve Whigham’s book, The Leader’s Guide to Tomorrow, this podcast invites future students, educators, parents, executives, and purpose-driven leaders to consider a deeper question:


What if education was designed not just to inform, but to transform?


The Whigham School Podcast is for those who believe the future of education must shape leaders marked by wisdom, humility, courage, cultural understanding, and a commitment to doing substantial good in the world.


About The Whigham School

The Whigham School is a graduate-level Global Studies program designed to develop culturally intelligent, globally experienced leaders through immersive learning across six continents and more than 40 countries.


The mission is to encourage a new generation of global leaders to do substantial good in the world.


Built around global understanding, global leadership, and global benevolence, The Whigham School prepares students to navigate complexity, engage across cultures, and use their education, profession, and influence as a force for human flourishing.


Students do more than study the world. They learn to understand it, engage with it, and help shape it.


For more information, please visit https://whighamschool.org/


About The Leader’s Guide to Tomorrow


The Leader’s Guide to Tomorrow by Steve Whigham helps illuminate the kind of leadership philosophy at the heart of The Whigham School.


The book explores the character, courage, wisdom, and moral imagination needed for the future — offering a framework for leaders who want to move beyond self-interest and contribute to something larger than themselves.


Together, The Whigham School and The Leader’s Guide to Tomorrow reflect a shared belief:


The world does not suffer from a lack of intelligence, ambition, or resources.

It suffers from a lack of courageous, morally grounded leadership.


For information, please visit https://thetomorrowleader.com/

title: Trust Control
author: Kate Kaye
description: Trust Control is a documentary podcast series about the weird yet surprisingly expansive world of trust measurement from investigative journalist and researcher Kate Kaye. Based on nearly a year of deep research and interviews with a wide variety of sources, the show takes listeners on a journey from the post-World War II Cold War period into the early days of the Internet through to today's agentic AI era. Trust – how it is measured, by whom and for what purposes – is the thread that carries us along throughout. Episodes dig into measurement of trust in AI and automation; media, news and information trustworthiness; the emerging realm of human and AI agent "worker" trust scoring, U.S. military and corporate management funding and influence in trust measurement, and more. Part historical documentary, part philosophical analysis, part provocative (and admittedly hokey) satire, Trust Control explores an emerging trust paradigm happening just below the surface of our digital lives… bubbling up to the surface of our real ones.

title: Vasectomy Clinics Of Chicago with Dr George Tsoutsias
author: Vasectomy Clinics of Chicago
description:
This channel is for the man who has already made his decision. His family is complete, or he and his partner know children aren't part of their future. 


But he can't seem to get past what he's read online. He's been through the Reddit threads. He's heard the stories from a buddy who had a rough time. 


And instead of getting clearer, he's gotten more anxious. He's looking for a physician who will tell him the truth about what a vasectomy actually is, what it actually does, and what to expect from someone who has done this thousands of times.


Vasectomy Clinics of Chicago has performed more than 30,000 vasectomies across five Chicagoland locations. Their physicians (board-certified surgeons who have dedicated their practice exclusively to this procedure) have seen one pattern more than any other: the fear is almost always larger than the reality. 


Nearly every nervous patient says the same thing on the way out: "That was so much easier than I expected." This channel exists to close that gap before the appointment, replacing what the internet gets wrong with what 30,000 cases actually teach you.

How To Overcome Porn, Lust & Other Compulsive Sexual Behaviors In 90 Days! 👇 

https://wellnessseekersultd.com/youtube

title: Trauma to Triumph
author: Angelina Garner
description:
Welcome to Trauma to Triumph, a space for raw, unfiltered conversations about childhood trauma, generational curses, and the journey toward true redemption. Hosted by me (Angelina Garner) this podcast dives deep into the realities of growing up amidst addiction, generational dysfunction, and broken families- and the heavy weight of the "normal" we inherit. 


If you are navigating the complexities of healing from abuse, trying to understand the effects of growing up in a dysfunctional family, or searching for a way out of the survival mode caused by surviving adversity, you are not alone. 


This is not just a story about the wreckage of the past; it's a testament to the fact that no matter how deep the ash, the cycle can stop with you. Each episode explores the path toward lasting faith-based healing and spiritual growth, offering a beacon of hope for anyone standing in the middle of their own brokenness. Discover why human strength eventually runs out, how grace meets us in the ruins, and how finding freedom in Jesus provides the ultimate anchor, complete overcoming trauma recovery, and a brand-new redemption story.

Each episode offers:


  • practical tools from CBT, DBT, and somatic therapy
  • nervous system education you can use in real life
  • intuitive insights and spiritual perspectives (without bypassing reality)
  • honest conversations about healing, growth, relationships, and becoming your most authentic self



This podcast is for you if you’re:


  • anxious, overwhelmed, or high-functioning but exhausted
  • spiritually curious but still want science-backed tools

If you’re looking for therapy-informed guidance with a soulful edge, The Mystic Therapist is your space to heal, rise, and roar.

Served Unfiltered is a podcast created and hosted by Vito Zahariev - an immigrant, a hospitality leader, a storyteller, and a man who has learned to rebuild himself through pressure, responsibility, and grit.

This show was born from a simple idea:
People don’t need another perfect podcast. They need the truth.
The messy truth. The immigrant truth. The leadership truth.
The version of life we don’t post on Instagram.

Every episode opens the door to conversations we usually avoid - identity, growth, fear, confidence, the immigrant journey, and the expectations we carry as adults trying to “figure life out.” With a brain that runs at 100 mph and English as a second language, Vito dives into real stories of self-improvement, culture shock, leadership mistakes, personal breakthroughs, and everything in between.

Here, nothing is rehearsed. Nothing is sugar-coated.
It’s raw, it’s honest, and it’s served unfiltered.

What to expect:

• The immigrant mindset and starting over in a new country
• Leadership in the real world - not the textbook version
• Pressure, burnout, ambition, and finding balance
• How to grow when comfort is the enemy
• Personal stories from Vito’s life, career, and experiences
• Mental battles we don’t talk about enough
• Lessons learned the hard way
• Conversations that feel like sitting at the table with a friend

This podcast is for anyone who’s ever felt behind, overwhelmed, misunderstood, or underestimated… and still wakes up and gives life another chance.

If you’re chasing better, pushing through fear, or building yourself from the ground up - welcome home.
This is your space. 

Episodes dropping weekly. 
Your seat at the table is ready.

SERVING REAL LIFE. REAL STORIES. REAL LESSONS.

Hip-hop history gets told two ways. Either it's a fan retrospective trading on nostalgia, or it's an insider interview show where the guest tells their own version of events. Provenance is neither. It's a researched, sourced, single-narrator documentary podcast that treats hip-hop's history with the same rigor a music historian would bring to jazz or rock and roll.


No guests. No opinions. No beef-baiting. Every episode traces a chain of custody, who actually built what, on top of whose idea, backed by documented sources, not just the version of the story that happened to stick. That includes the flagship names everyone already knows, Wu-Tang Clan, Dr. Dre, Nas, and it includes the founders history has a habit of writing out of the story, the women, the queer artists, the international scenes, and the executives whose names never made it onto the credits despite building the business the whole genre stands on.


Every episode runs 25 minutes and up, released weekly. New episodes every Wednesday.

Welcome to At the Table, the Food Allergy Podcast brought to you in partnership with Genentech and Novartis. Here we talk food, connection, and living with food allergies.
 
Each episode, we pull up a chair to a different table—from date nights to family dinners to tables abroad—and talk about what it really means to navigate each moment while still eating safely.
 
Hosted by actress and producer Jenna Ushkowitz, mom to a little one with food allergies, and chef and restaurateur Tyler Florence, who as a child was diagnosed with 42 food allergies, the two bring their perspectives to real stories from people living with food allergies—the challenges but also the wins.
 
Because living with food allergies isn’t just about what you can’t eat; it’s about still having your seat at the table.
 
What is XOLAIR?
 
XOLAIR® (omalizumab) for subcutaneous use is an injectable prescription medicine used to treat food allergy in people 1 year of age and older to reduce allergic reactions that may occur after accidentally eating one or more foods to which you are allergic. While taking XOLAIR you should continue to avoid all foods to which you are allergic. It is not known if XOLAIR is safe and effective in people with food allergy under 1 year of age.
 
XOLAIR should not be used for the emergency treatment of any allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis.
 
What is the most important information I should know about XOLAIR?
Severe allergic reaction. A severe allergic reaction called anaphylaxis can happen when you receive XOLAIR. The reaction can occur after the first dose, or after many doses. It may also occur right after a XOLAIR injection or days later. Anaphylaxis is a life-threatening condition and can lead to death. Go to the nearest emergency room right away if you have any of these symptoms of an allergic reaction:
wheezing, shortness of breath, cough, chest tightness, or trouble breathing
low blood pressure, dizziness, fainting, rapid or weak heartbeat, anxiety, or feeling of “impending doom” 
flushing, itching, hives, or feeling warm
swelling of the throat or tongue, throat tightness, hoarse voice, or trouble swallowing
 
Your healthcare provider will monitor you closely for symptoms of an allergic reaction while you are receiving XOLAIR and for a period of time after treatment is initiated. Your healthcare provider should talk to you about getting medical treatment if you have symptoms of an allergic reaction.
Please see the full Prescribing Information for additional safety information, including Boxed Warning, and Medication Guide by visiting bit.ly/XOLPI

title: The Guest List
author: David Ventura
description: The Guest List is the interview show from Forefront, the Front&Centre® podcast network, hosted by David Ventura.  Each episode is one guest and one honest, properly produced conversation about winning, keeping and growing the customers that matter most. David sits down with the leaders, operators and independent thinkers who actually put their ideas into practice in real business - the people worth putting front and centre.  Expect straight talk on customer experience, key account management, sales, service, brand, and where technology and humans meet. No jargon, no filler. And every episode ends with the ugly mirror moment: one uncomfortable question that asks the guest to name the thing they know is broken and keep not fixing.  One seat. The right people. Your work, made visible.  Front&Centre helps businesses win, keep and grow the customers that matter most. More at frontandcentre.com.

title: Mornings on MainStreet
author: Charles Whitson
description:
🌄 Mornings on MainStreet is Taos MainStreet’s monthly radio show on KNCE 93.5FM. Where community, culture, and conversation meet. Each month, we shine a light on the people, projects, and ideas shaping the heart of Downtown Taos.

From local history and arts to downtown revitalization and tourism, we’re exploring what makes Taos unique while looking ahead to its future. Whether you live here, love visiting, or just want to know more about our vibrant community, this is your front-row seat to the stories of Taos.

Tune in, get inspired, and join us in celebrating and strengthening our downtown together.

title: 2026 Southwest Believers' Convention
author: Kenneth Copeland Ministries
description: Immerse yourself in the Word alongside thousands of other believers from around the world and learn to apply God’s Word to daily life. Enjoy Spirit-led praise and worship, and mountain-moving corporate prayer each day and night at SWBC. This event is for the whole family, so bring your children and teens for their own exciting services.

title: The Pack Pod
author: Parker West
description: The Pack Pod is a Green Bay Packers podcast focused on thoughtful analysis, honest conversations, and a fan-first perspective. From game reactions and roster moves to training camp, the Draft, and everything in between, join Parker West as he breaks down the team through the eyes of a passionate fan who never stopped studying the game.

title: DPS: The Next Level
author: Dayton Public Schools
description: DPS: The Next Level is moderated by Dr. Lawrence, Superintendent of Dayton Public Schools. This podcast will share important topics with staff throughout the school year.

title: Connected Cold Chain
author: SkyCell
description:
Connected Cold Chain brings together the voices behind today’s pharmaceutical supply chains — the people shaping, running, and improving them.
Each episode features honest conversations, fresh perspectives, and shared experiences on how the industry is evolving and what it takes to build a more connected cold chain.
A monthly podcast for those who want to stay informed and ahead.

title: The Uplift with Dutch Phoenix
author: Dutch Phoenix
description:
The Uplift is the show where you want to experience The Moment, because that is where things start to make sense . 
Host Dutch Phoenix reveals the deeper realities that influence our thoughts, feelings and choices so you can see clearly why and how things work leading you to see what’s possible.
Real growth, Clear direction Expanding what’s possible for you!
Weekday mornings
10 AM ET | 7 AM PT

title: Weekend Politics with Jonathan Jacobs
author: Attorney Jonathan Jacobs
description: Weekend Politics with Jonathan Jacobs breaks down the week’s biggest political stories and is your definitive weekly debrief on political power, policy, and national news. Combining insightful commentary with the key sound bites that defined the week, host Attorney Jonathan Jacobs dissects legislative battles, campaign maneuvers, and deep-seated policy debates. Every episode breaks down the week's biggest headlines, deconstructs beltway strategy, and plays the raw soundbites politicians hope you'll forget. Get the signal without the noise. New episodes drop every weekend.

title: Aidan MacLennan Stories
author: Aidan Stories
description: A series of stories for my little boy, Aidan. To help him sleep and entertain him. Enjoy.

title: 101 Mistakes Humans Make to Mess Up Their Dogs with Dina Zaphiris
author: Dina Zaphiris
description: Based on her new book, 101 Mistakes Humans Make to Mess Up Their Dogs, renowned dog trainer and author Dina Zaphiris reveals the everyday habits that weaken communication, motivation, trust, and reliability. Each episode challenges common dog-training advice, explains behavior from the dog’s point of view, and gives you practical ways to create a dog who wants to listen—not one who simply has to. Expect honest talk, real examples, and a completely different way to think about training.
